name: B10-0111/2026 (The Left) – Targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling for action. It says Türkiye has expelled foreign journalists and more than 200 foreign Christians, calling them national security threats, and has deported people from Syria, Afghanistan and Iran, sometimes forcing Syrians to sign "voluntary return" forms. It asks the European Union to suspend its 2016 migration deal with Türkiye and to make respect for rights a condition of their relationship.

- No law changes; Parliament only asks the EU to suspend the 2016 migration deal with Türkiye.
- Affects foreign journalists, Christian communities and migrants in Türkiye, plus EU–Türkiye relations.
- Next: the request goes to EU institutions, member states and Turkish authorities, who decide.
